requirements.hint: Requirements Minimum Credits: 15 Foundational Course: WGS / SOC 216 — Thinking Class: Inequality in Media, Bodies, Environment, and More or SOC 242 — The Experience of Social Class in College and the CommunityOf the total 15 credits, at least six credits must be taken in Women's and Gender Studies.Electives: Four electives (12 credits) from a list of approved courses. At least two courses must be at the 300 level or above, with at least one at the 400 level.
